    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    HttpHandler
    Manages the HTTP request and response lifecycle for a client connection.
    HttpWorker
    Implements a worker thread to manage individual HTTP connections concurrently.
    Request
    Manages the parsing and reading of HTTP requests from a client connection.
    Response
    Manages HTTP responses, handling request routing to static files or directory listings, and generating appropriate HTTP success, redirect, or error responses.
    RunThreadPooledWebServer
    Main application class that boots and runs the thread-pooled web server.
    ServerSettings
    Manages the configuration settings of the web server and handles reading properties from the configuration file.
    ThreadPooledWebServer
    Implements a multithreaded web server using a fixed thread pool to manage incoming client connections concurrently.
    WebServerException
    Custom runtime exception used to handle errors specific to the web server execution, socket management, or I/O operations.
    WebServerTest
    Test the Web Server
